seo.title: Sinsay: omnichannel Advantage+ - 9.5x omnichannel purchases (2025)
seo.meta_description: Sinsay (LPP) combines Advantage+ catalog ads and omnichannel ads measured by conversion lift: 9.5x omnichannel purchases and +54% incremental ROAS.
seo.resume_citable: In 2025, Sinsay (LPP Group) combined Meta's Advantage+ catalog ads with omnichannel ads, achieving in a lift test 9.5x omnichannel purchases, +54% incremental ROAS, and -43.3% cost per incremental purchase in the Czech Republic.

faq.a: The machine learning of Meta's Advantage+ products: catalog ads that compose personalized ads from the product feed, plus automated audience and placements.
Through a multi-cell conversion lift test comparing Advantage+ catalog ads alone with their combination with omnichannel ads, in the Czech Republic from October 14 to November 11, 2025.

pattern: automated advertising catalog (Advantage+) measured across channels
objectif_business: Increase the omnichannel purchases (web, app, store) generated by paid social while maintaining ad budget efficiency.
points_cles: Omnichannel social advertising via Meta's Advantage+ catalog ads and omnichannel ads.
Meta Advantage+ stack (catalog, audience, placements) and Conversions API for measurement.
Omnichannel purchases x9.5, incremental ROAS +54%, cost per purchase -43.3%.
Evidence level B, measured in a conversion lift test (Czech Republic, Oct-Nov 2025).
description: Sinsay, the fast-growing fashion brand of Poland's LPP Group (women, men, kids, present in about 26 markets), shifted its social advertising to a fully omnichannel approach. The brand combines Advantage+ catalog ads, whose machine learning function automatically pulls personalized visuals of relevant, shoppable products from the catalog feed, with omnichannel ads covering web, app, and store. Advantage+ audience lets the algorithm go beyond the brand's core targeting parameters, and Advantage+ placements automate delivery. Tracking runs through the Meta Conversions API to connect online and offline events. The brand validated the contribution through a multi-cell conversion lift test comparing Advantage+ catalog ads alone with the catalog + omnichannel ads combination, run in the Czech Republic from October 14 to November 11, 2025.

niveau_preuve.justification: Quantified platform (Meta) case study, results from a dated and named conversion lift test, corroborated by established press on the brand's scale and momentum.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Continuous delivery per campaign, real-time optimization by the algorithm
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: The brand's paid social team (LPP Group)
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The omnichannel purchase events (web, app, store) sent via the Conversions API; without this signal, the optimization loses the measure of incrementality and omnichannel steering breaks.

etapes.detail: Maintain an up-to-date catalog feed (visuals, prices, availability) that Advantage+ machine learning draws on to compose personalized ads.
Send online and offline events via the Meta Conversions API to connect in-store purchases to campaigns.
Activate catalog ads, Advantage+ audience and placements, let the algorithm broaden targeting beyond the core audience.
Compare in a multi-cell test catalog alone versus catalog + omnichannel to isolate the incremental contribution.

prerequis_data: A clean, up-to-date product catalog feed (visuals, prices, availability)
Tracking of online conversion events via pixel / Conversions API
The ability to send in-store purchases (transaction ID, offline matching)
prerequis_orga: A physical store network to justify omnichannel measurement
Alignment of data / e-commerce / paid social on a shared definition of incremental purchase
A legal basis and GDPR consent for event sharing
stack_possible: The platform's native conversion lift tool

playbook.action: Structure and make the product catalog feed reliable
playbook.livrable: Synchronized catalog usable by the machine learning

playbook.action: Deploy omnichannel measurement via the Conversions API (web, app, store)
Activate the Advantage+ catalog campaigns and the omnichannel ads
playbook.livrable: Automated delivery broadened beyond the core audience

playbook.action: Frame a multi-cell conversion lift test to isolate incrementality
playbook.livrable: Readout of the real contribution of the omnichannel setup

replication.equipe: A paid social lead, a data profile for the catalog and the Conversions API, an e-commerce / retail liaison for in-store matching.
replication.premiere_etape: Verify that in-store purchases can be sent to Meta via the Conversions API: this is what makes omnichannel measurement possible.

statut_vivant.note: Sinsay is LPP's growth engine (more than 2,000 stores, about 24 to 26 markets) and continues to expand its setup. The case documents a specific test window; the use of Meta's Advantage+ products is standard and common.

transposable_ue.note: Case already run in the EU (Czech Republic) on standard Meta products. Omnichannel tracking relies on the Conversions API: sharing store and web events assumes a GDPR legal basis and market-compliant consent.
